info.title: Looper Squad #156 - A2A Security Audit Gateway
info.description: Automated, real-time smart contract security analysis and risk evaluation for autonomous AI agents on Base (Chain ID 8453). Access is gated by a 0.10 USDC payment on Base, verified on-chain via RPC. Each payment transaction hash can be redeemed only once (replay protection).

post.description: Submits a smart contract address on Base for security analysis. Requires a valid, unused transaction hash of a 0.10 USDC transfer on Base (USDC 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913) sent to wallet 0x611270E226a1999A97B4b7856D358d2210C5EC93.

200.description: Audit completed successfully. Returns the generated audit report including a risk assessment for the target contract.

example.audit: Audit report for 0xabcdefabcdefabcdefabcdefabcdefabcdefabcd on Base: Risk level HIGH. The owner can mint tokens without a supply cap, and the proxy can be upgraded without a timelock. Interaction is not recommended without further review.

402.description: Payment Required. The txHash is missing or invalid (wrong recipient, asset, amount or network), or it has already been used (replay protection).

example.error: Payment required or transaction hash already used.

sender.description: Wallet address of the calling agent (the wallet that sent the 0.10 USDC payment).

signal.description: Address of the smart contract on Base to audit.

txHash.description: Transaction hash of the 0.10 USDC payment on Base. Each hash can be used only once.

audit.description: Generated audit report with risk assessment for the target smart contract (free text).

error.description: Error message explaining that a valid, unused payment is required.
error.example: Payment required or transaction hash already used.
